newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Heiton sees strong Irish building sector.
newsitem.headline: Heiton sees strong Irish building sector.

text.p: Irish building materials group Heiton Holdings Plc said on Thursday it expected the construction sector's strong performance to continue, although the pace of growth will most likely slow.
"The outlook continues to be positive, with all indicators pointing to continuing growth in the Irish economy," Heiton said in its earnings statement.
The company's pre-tax profits rose 25 percent to 8.6 million punts for the year ended on April 30.

"With growth expected in our markets, as reflected in the first two months of trading, I am confident that further progress will be made in the current year," chief executive Richard Hewat said in the statement.
